QuestInfo.name: Happy Little Paints-1
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra's trying to restore a painting and she could use your help.
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra needs you to get her paint back to save the Fading Painting.\n#rCheck out all the different categories in the Cash Shop, and you should find her paint.
QuestInfo.2: You found all of Cassandra's paint in the Cash Shop!

0.0: Why didn't I buy them, #h0#?! There was an ad on my crystal ball and I had the mesos, but did I buy them? No! WHY did I think I could fix a cursed painting? I've never painted anything!\nI failed finger painting in kindergarten! Three people had to go to the hospital!
0.1: Ohhh, if only I had some sucker to... HEY! YOU can help me, can't you? You have to. Say yes.\nHit accept right now.

yes.0: Another victim of the Cassandranator!\nI need #b1#i4033736# #t4033736##k. Like, super magic paint, that will do all the work for me.\nI saw an ad for some in the#r Cash Shop#k, if you wanna start there.

no.0: YOU ARE THE WORST... painting assistant that I have talked to in the last three minutes.

1.0: Oh geez, I didn't think that was going to work. Now I have to work on this thing all night. THANKS A LOT!!

yes.0: I was being sarcastic, but really thank you. I do NOT want to have to give back the deposit I got for this restoration.\nThose leg warmers really set me back on rent.

item.0: I dunno where they put all the paint, but I KNOW I saw them in the #rCash Shop#k.\n I think. Just like, go shopping! Go look at every category.
